description: The apps a store's search returns for a keyword, in order, with rating and reviews. A first lookup takes 5 to 20 seconds; if it answers with an error saying it is not ready, nothing is charged and the same call a minute later returns it. $0.005 a keyword.

depth.description: Default 10; up to 100 on the App Store, 30 on Google Play.

language.description: Two-letter language code; Chinese is "zh-TW" or "zh-CN". Default "en".

name: app_search
title: App store search results
